paragraphs: He reports R' Yochanan in Shabbat 25a. He is also mentioned in Taanit 24b according to the reading of Ein Yaakov, while our text reads R' Nachman bar Ushpazti.[^1]

notes.text: ע״י is contextually read as Ein Yaakov, an unverified work-siglum interpretation rather than the old claim of a manuscript. כה./כד: give 25a/24b by convention without new edition checks. א״ר יוחנן introduces the headed Nachman’s report from Yochanan, not a statement about him. ר״נ is contextually Nachman, with its title R'; the heading’s explicit Rav is not transferred. Ushpazti differs from Oshaya and gains no identity binding.
